summary: Examples test whether /etc/hosts is absolute and reject absolute paths from a list to keep relative ones.
questions: How do I filter a list to only relative paths?
How do I test that a single path is absolute?

answer_card.title: abs test examples
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
is_path_absolute: "{{ '/etc/hosts' is abs }}"
relative_paths: "{{ all_paths | reject('abs') }}"
```
